verdict.rationale: Godot is MIT-licensed open source with its full source on GitHub, documented compilation for every supported platform, and permission to redistribute modified versions. The runtime probe confirms a keyless one-command install of a binary that runs headless for CI, exports and editor automation, and Godot can also run headless as a dedicated server. Nothing depends on a vendor-hosted service, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own machines. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party self-hosting or deployment guide for running the editor and toolchain on user-managed infrastructure (for example in containers), beyond the headless and dedicated-server notes.
